description: Least-privilege capability set for the main window (architecture.md Section 9.2). Grants only Tauri's core defaults required for the window to run. The custom `app_version` command is NOT authorized here: in Tauri v2 user-defined `#[tauri::command]` handlers are gated solely by being registered in `generate_handler!` (see src/main.rs), not by a capability permission token. Capability permissions like `core:app:*` govern Tauri's built-in plugins, which Phase 0 does not use.
